title: QuantumScape makes its move on data centers
key_facts: Solid-state battery company QuantumScape announced its first product for data centers on Thursday 8 Oct 2026, the QS PowerBlock.
It is touted for high power density, long runtime and greater safety than conventional lithium-ion batteries.
The design can be configured for a large variety of data center equipment sizes and formats.
Cells have shown stability well above 300°C in third-party tests; conventional lithium-ion can enter thermal runaway around 180°C, QuantumScape says.
CEO Siva Sivaram says insurability and permitting could improve and 'you can shave months off of permitting'.
Talks with potential customers are under way; first uses likely in large training data centers.
quote_evidence: Solid-state battery company QuantumScape on Thursday announced its first product for data centers.
Sivaram said talks are underway with potential customers.
why_it_matters_hint: A battery maker moves into AI data centers with a safety pitch; claims are its own.
